title: Latest calls on Home, socials in the menu
items: Home shows Matchday's latest calls under the public record: the best recent call against the market and, when there is one, the toughest recent miss. Both come from the same locked, graded picks as the Scorecard.
The model / market list on Home shows the top six differences, so the columns line up without empty space.
X, YouTube and TikTok links sit at the bottom of the navigation, and in the More sheet on phones.
